# ruststream-gcp-pubsub

> `ruststream-gcp-pubsub` is the Google Cloud Pub/Sub broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. It runs over the official `google-cloud-pubsub` client: a streaming pull subscription is the message stream a handler reads, acknowledgement is native and per message, and an ordering key is the framework's partition key.

A subscription is the descriptor `GooglePubSub`, which names an existing subscription and carries every setting it takes: flow control, the ack deadline extension, the batch wait and how long one delivery may stay unsettled. A retry cap and a dead-letter topic named at the mount site become the subscription's own dead-letter policy. A routes file imports `ruststream_gcp_pubsub::prelude::*`, which offers `PubSubPublish` as `Publish`; the ordering key of one publish is its per-message setting.

This site holds the entry pages. The crate's guide is its overview on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Site

- [Home](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/): what the crate gives you, the dependency lines and a first service
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/benchmarks/): what this crate's consumer and publisher cost over the raw `google-cloud-pubsub` client on the emulator, and how to re-measure it with `just bench`

## Guide

- [Overview](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html): the transport and a service
- [Subscribing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#subscribing): the descriptor and its settings
- [Capping the retries](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#capping-the-retries): the retry cap and dead-letter topic as the subscription's dead-letter policy
- [Settling a delivery](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#settling-a-delivery): acknowledgement, including the confirmed form on exactly-once subscriptions
- [Batches](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#batches): batch handlers and the batch wait
- [Publishing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#publishing): the publish policy, replies and the ordering key
- [The prelude](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#the-prelude): what a routes file and a handler file import
- [The AsyncAPI document](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#the-asyncapi-document): what the `asyncapi` feature reports
- [Testing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/testing/index.html): the in-process broker behind the `testing` feature, driven by `TestApp`
- [Operations](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/ruststream_gcp_pubsub/index.html#operations): credentials, endpoints, the emulator and ordered delivery
